events.description: Large-scale violent confrontation between riot police in full protective gear (helmets, shields) and a crowd of protesters on a city street; smoke/fire visible in background, objects being thrown, and physical clashes occurring throughout the sequence.

Direct physical combat observed: individuals in civilian clothing engage in hand-to-hand fighting with riot police, including grappling, pushing, and use of improvised weapons (e.g., sticks, poles); one individual in green jacket is actively striking officers.

Sudden bright orange flash and rapid expansion of smoke/fire at center-left background (near barricades), consistent with an explosion or incendiary device detonation; distinct from sustained fire seen earlier.

Sustained violent clash between two groups: one in dark uniforms with helmets and shields (likely law enforcement), and another group of civilians wearing helmets, masks, and improvised protection, wielding sticks, poles, and shields. The scene is chaotic, smoke-filled, with fire visible in the background (e.g., f0, f2). Multiple individuals are engaged in aggressive pushing, striking, and grappling throughout the sequence.

Multiple instances of mutual physical combat: individuals from opposing sides engage in direct hand-to-hand fighting, using sticks and fists; e.g., at f3 a person in green helmet swings a pole while being pushed back; at f5 a person in white helmet is struck and falls; at f10–f12, several pairs are seen grappling and striking each other simultaneously.

A person in a white helmet is on the ground (f4–f5), and multiple individuals from the opposing group surround and strike them while they are down (e.g., f5 shows at least two attackers swinging objects toward the prone individual). This constitutes attacking a helpless victim.
Sustained violent group clash involving multiple individuals wearing helmets and masks, wielding sticks, shields, and throwing debris; smoke and chaos indicate active riot conditions.
Multiple instances of mutual physical combat: individuals striking each other with sticks, grappling, and using shields offensively/defensively in close quarters.
A person in white helmet is on the ground (f2–f4) while others strike or stomp near them; in f3–f4, a figure appears to be kicking or striking a prone individual amid crowd pressure.

A chaotic street confrontation with multiple individuals engaged in violent group clashes: people use makeshift shields and throw objects, while others are on the ground amid smoke and fire in the background.
Mutual physical combat is visible: individuals grapple, push, and strike each other; one person in a tan coat is actively engaged in close-quarters struggle with others holding shields.

A person lies motionless on the ground surrounded by rubble; others walk past or stand nearby without assistance, and at least one individual appears to kick or step on the prone person (visible in f7–f11). The victim shows no defensive movement, indicating helplessness.

A masked individual in black repeatedly strikes a prone, helmeted person on the ground with a wooden stick or baton, while the victim remains motionless and unresponsive. The attacker maintains control and continues the assault over several seconds.

The scene depicts a chaotic urban environment with debris, multiple individuals in riot gear (black helmets), and at least two aggressors engaging in violent acts against a fallen person, consistent with collective violent unrest.
A masked individual in dark clothing repeatedly strikes a person lying prone on the ground with a wooden object (appears to be a bat or plank), while other individuals and riot police observe nearby.

Ongoing violent unrest: debris-strewn street, multiple riot police in helmets forming a line in foreground, masked individuals engaging in aggression, and background fire/smoke indicating destruction and confrontation.

A second individual (in light jacket) approaches the scene and appears to engage physically with the masked attacker or the victim, involving close proximity and dynamic movement suggesting mutual or attempted intervention combat.
